enrichment.summary: Three-bedroom, 75 m² apartment with a lift and full air conditioning, plus a modern American kitchen. Guests praise the central location and polished interior; exact fixed-bed layout and toilet/shower counts are not detailed in the listing.

photoReview.bestPhotoReason: Bright lead image of the dining and kitchen area, showing an attractive, usable shared space.
issues: A lift is listed, but the floor and remaining access route are not described.
The listing mentions a sofa for an additional guest; sofa sleeping capacity is excluded from proper-bed count.

themes: All four reviewed guests describe a very positive stay; several praise the apartment's comfort, design and location.
Guests praise responsive hosts and convenient access to restaurants, shops and sightseeing.
concerns: One review notes weekend street noise; another mentions no air conditioning in summer, though the listing advertises air conditioning.
conflicts: One review says there was no air conditioning, while the listing states full air conditioning.
